name: benchmark_image_zhang
description:
Description
	

This dataset contains a collection of various image sets, used for benchmarking in image processing tasks, for publications made by the group of Kai Zhang, formerly with EDF Zurich and now with Nanjing University.
Specifically, the images were collected:

	
		
		ffhq_val
	

The Flickr-Faces-HQ dataset contains a subset of human faces.
This version contains a subset of images of size 256x256 downloaded from:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/danaroth/benchmark_image_zhang.
reputation: Widely used within the image restoration and super-resolution research community as standard test image collections associated with Kai Zhang's group.
